0.0: Hello, there, nice to meet you. I'm #b#p1022006##k the archeologist, and I'm looking for fossils of the prehistoric life.
0.1: Perion may now be a land of dry, rocky mountains, but it used to be a fertile land full of tall trees and lots of creatures, much like Ellinia. Can you believe that? I'm looking for evidence from that era. If you are not busy and all, can you help me out?

yes.0: Thank you. I ran into something odd yesterday. I went to Perion for some food, and when I came back, I found my tent raided by the monsters. They took my fossils and ran away.
yes.1: Looking at the footprints, it seems like #b#o2230102##k and #b#o1140100##k did it. Please take care of them and gather #b100 #t4031146#s#k and 100 #b#t4031147#s#k for me. Thanks and good luck!

no.0: Kids these days are so selfish, saying no to an old man's favor. Fine, please leave.

item.0: I don't think you've gathered them all up, yet. These materials are important. Please try harder.
